# `json_tuple`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a tuple like the function get_json_object, but it takes multiple names. All the input parameters and output column types are string.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
json_tuple(jsonStr, p1, p2, ..., pn)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `json_funcs` |
| Kind | generator (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.6.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | > 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- json_tuple, example 1
> SELECT json_tuple('{"a":1, "b":2}', 'a', 'b');
1 | 2
```
